{{2005–06 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}}

The '''2006 [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] [[SEC men's basketball tournament|men's basketball tournament]]''' took place from March 9–12, 2006 in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] at the [[Sommet Center|Gaylord Entertainment Center]]. The SEC Championship Game was televised by [[CBS Sports|CBS]].

The top two teams in both the Eastern and Western Divisions received byes in the first round, which were [[University of Tennessee|Tennessee]], [[Alabama Crimson Tide basketball|Alabama]], [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU]], and [[Florida Gators|Florida]] and played their second round games on March 10, 2006. The SEC Tournament winner (Florida) received the SEC's automatic bid to the NCAA Tournament en route to winning the [[2006 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2006 NCAA National Championship]].
